researchTarget: XTND post-merger capitalization and dilution normalization
researchQuestion: Can independent post-close SEC evidence narrow the open XTND capitalization/runway directive without double-counting merger consideration, rollover awards, pre-funded warrants, or new employee plans?
summary: Independent post-close SEC review materially improves the dilution map but does not yet establish a clean exact post-close basic-share denominator or normalized operating runway. The September 4 S-8 confirms 43,567,442 registered employee/rollover-plan shares: 9,936,483 rollover-award shares, 18,630,959 shares under the 2026 equity incentive plan, and 15,000,000 under the ESPP. Only the two new-plan buckets (33,630,959 shares) should be treated as prospective plan capacity for a first-pass overhang estimate; the rollover-award bucket is transaction-linked compensation and may already overlap with merger capitalization. Relative to the existing 277,442,600 pro-forma weighted-average denominator, the two new-plan buckets equal about 12.1%, while all S-8 buckets together equal about 15.7%; neither percentage is an exact dilution forecast. The S-4 registration framework separately allowed up to 24,873,730 pre-funded warrants, but those warrants were designed as an alternative form of merger consideration for specified holders and therefore must not be automatically added on top of the pro-forma merger denominator. A September 4 shelf prospectus confirms no preferred stock outstanding at that date and broad future financing flexibility, but it does not disclose an exact post-close common-share count. The Chief quarantine remains justified.

evidence.claim: XTND's September 4, 2026 S-8 registers 9,936,483 rollover-award shares, 18,630,959 shares under the 2026 equity incentive plan, and 15,000,000 ESPP shares.

The S-8 describes cash exercise of JFB warrants for 3,328,407 shares at $2.875 and 16,137,866 shares at $3.125, plus cashless exercise of remaining JFB warrants resulting in 6,999,928 shares, all converted one-for-one into XTND common stock; Xtend ordinary shares converted at 1.36 XTND shares per Xtend share.

The merger registration statement contemplated up to 24,873,730 pre-funded warrants tied to specified JFB Series C preferred-stock and warrant holders; these instruments are an alternative settlement form in the merger registration framework and should not be assumed incremental without holder-level reconciliation.

The existing unaudited pro-forma disclosure reports 277,442,600 pro-forma weighted-average basic and diluted shares for June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, built from Xtend historical shares, conversion adjustments, preferred/warrant/SAFE conversion, and JFB-security consideration.

XTND's September 4 shelf prospectus states there were no preferred shares outstanding as of the prospectus date and preserves broad future securities-issuance flexibility; it does not provide an exact post-close common-share count in the reviewed text.

Post-close Form 3 filings confirm individual insiders received merger-close common shares and rollover options, supporting the need to reconcile holder-level rollover awards separately from plan capacity rather than treating all S-8 registration as new dilution.

inferences.inference: The 18,630,959-share equity-plan bucket plus the 15,000,000-share ESPP bucket represent 33,630,959 shares of prospective registered plan capacity, approximately 12.1% of the 277,442,600 pro-forma weighted-average denominator. This is an overhang ratio, not a forecast of issuance or economic dilution.

All S-8 buckets total 43,567,442 shares, approximately 15.7% of the same pro-forma denominator, but that larger figure should not be used as prospective dilution because the 9,936,483 rollover-award shares are transaction-linked and may already overlap the merger capitalization basis.

The 24,873,730 pre-funded-warrant maximum is approximately 9.0% of the 277,442,600 pro-forma denominator, but adding it wholesale to that denominator would risk double counting because the filing describes those warrants as merger-consideration alternatives for specified security holders.

XTND has meaningful financing optionality immediately after listing, as evidenced by the shelf registration and equity-plan registrations; financing flexibility is real, but imminent issuance volume, timing and price are unknown and should not be inferred from registration capacity alone.

findings: The current 277,442,600 figure remains a pro-forma weighted-average denominator, not proven exact September 2026 basic shares outstanding.
The cleanest independently supportable prospective plan-overhang bucket is 33,630,959 shares from the new 2026 equity incentive plan plus ESPP, roughly 12.1% of the pro-forma denominator.
The 9,936,483 rollover-award S-8 bucket should be reconciled against merger/insider rollover awards before being counted as incremental dilution.
The 24,873,730 pre-funded-warrant ceiling should be holder-reconciled; it cannot safely be added to the pro-forma denominator as wholly incremental.
No preferred stock was outstanding as of the September 4 shelf prospectus, reducing one immediate capitalization ambiguity but not resolving common/pre-funded-warrant counts.

Runway remains unresolved because gross $60 million/$110 million transaction-capital headlines do not substitute for normalized post-close operating cash burn, restricted cash, transaction costs, debt-like obligations and working-capital requirements.
contradictions: Registration capacity is much larger than the currently proven economic issuance base; treating registered S-8/shelf securities as already outstanding would materially overstate dilution.

The pro-forma weighted-average denominator is useful for scale but is not the same accounting concept as exact closing-date basic shares outstanding, so the open Chief directive cannot be closed from that table alone.
unknowns: Exact XTND common shares outstanding immediately after the September 3, 2026 closing.
Exact number of merger pre-funded warrants actually issued versus common shares, by holder and beneficial-ownership limitation.
Which portion of the 9,936,483 rollover-award S-8 shares was already economically represented in the pro-forma weighted-average denominator.
Post-close normalized quarterly operating cash burn, cash available after transaction costs and restrictions, and therefore defensible cash runway.
Actual future utilization rate and timing of the 2026 equity incentive plan and ESPP capacity.
falsifiers: A subsequent 10-Q, 8-K, prospectus supplement or audited closing capitalization table that states exact post-close common shares and pre-funded warrants could replace the current provisional denominator and invalidate these overhang ratios.
If the 2026 equity-plan or ESPP registrations are materially reduced, cancelled, or shown to replace already-counted awards, the 12.1% prospective-plan-capacity estimate would be overstated.

If holder-level merger records show the pre-funded warrants were incremental to, rather than substitutes within, the disclosed merger consideration denominator, the current double-counting caution would need revision.
recommendedActionDetail: Keep XTND quarantined from admission/opportunity scoring. Use this artifact to narrow the directive: treat 33,630,959 new-plan/ESPP shares as identifiable prospective registration capacity, explicitly exclude the 9,936,483 rollover bucket and 24,873,730 pre-funded-warrant ceiling from any incremental-dilution sum until holder-level closing capitalization is reconciled. Next-best source is a post-close 10-Q/8-K/prospectus supplement or transfer-agent/outstanding-share disclosure that states exact common and pre-funded-warrant counts; separately normalize post-close cash burn before runway assessment.
